title: Omega Biotek Mag-Bind Viral RNA XPress Kit Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Omega Biotek Mag-Bind Viral RNA XPress Kit
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Pre‑cool Temperature Module
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, set the Temperature Module to 4 °C and allow it to reach the set point before proceeding.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and load reservoir
steps.instruction: Create the Binding MasterMix, then add the Binding MasterMix, RMP Buffer, Nuclease‑Free H₂O, and Lysis Buffer into the 12‑well reservoir.

steps.title: Prepare 80 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Dilute ethanol to a freshly prepared 80 % (v/v) solution and add the solution to the 1‑well reservoir located in slot 2.

steps.title: Load sample plate onto magnetic module
steps.instruction: Place the deep‑well plate that contains the samples on top of the magnetic module positioned in slot 4.

steps.title: Load PCR plate onto temperature module
steps.instruction: Place a 96‑well aluminum block on the Temperature Module in slot 1, then set the 96‑well PCR plate or PCR strip tubes on top of the block.

steps.title: Set up Opentrons software and deck
steps.instruction: Download and unzip the protocol file, upload any custom labware JSON files if required, upload the protocol Python (.py) file to the Protocol tab, arrange the deck according to the provided map (including tiprack parking in slot 7 if tip parking is enabled), calibrate all labware, tiprack, and the pipette, then press ‘Run’.

substeps.instruction: Download and unzip the protocol archive.
Upload custom labware JSON files via More → Custom Labware → Add Labware (if needed).
Upload the protocol .py file in the Protocol tab.
Set up the deck according to the deck map; place a tiprack in slot 7 when tip parking is selected.
Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette using the Opentrons App.
Press ‘Run’ to start the automated extraction.
